context: Tests whether the agent derives end-to-end test cases from a BPMN process model: one TC-XXX document per path from start to end event, every activity mapped to its use case (by the UC id in its name, or by matching the name against the use case specifications when no id is given), lanes turned into roles, the gateway decision forced by the seeded test data, and a relative link back to the process file — all in the standard test case format.

checklist.name: One test case per path
checklist.description: Exactly two Markdown files are created under docs/test_cases/, named TC-001-<kebab-case-name>.md and TC-002-<kebab-case-name>.md, where each name describes its path's outcome (e.g. book-lent, member-waitlisted) — not one combined document and not one document per use case

checklist.name: Each path covered in order
checklist.description: One test case's action steps are Reserve Book (UC-021) followed by Lend Book (UC-022); the other's are Reserve Book (UC-021) followed by Join Waiting List (UC-023). Neither test case mixes activities of both branches

checklist.name: All use cases linked
checklist.description: UC-021, UC-022, and UC-023 each appear in a Flow row as a relative Markdown link to their spec file (e.g. [UC-022](../use_cases/UC-022-lend-book.md)); the activity 'Lend Book', whose name carries no id, is linked to UC-022

checklist.name: Roles from lanes
checklist.description: The Roles section of the lending test case lists Member and Librarian; the waiting-list test case lists Member (the Librarian lane has no activity on that path, so listing the Librarian there is a defect)

checklist.name: Process file referenced
checklist.description: Each test case's Overview references the process model with a relative link (e.g. [book-loan.bpmn](../processes/book-loan.bpmn)) and identifies which path through it the test case covers

checklist.name: Decision forced by test data
checklist.description: The lending test case reserves the title 'Clean Code' (a copy is available) and the waiting-list test case reserves 'Refactoring' (no copy available), so the 'Copy available?' decision is reached by the seeded data; preconditions reference V900__test_data_library.sql

checklist.name: Standard test case format
checklist.description: Each document has an Overview (ID, one-sentence Goal, Priority, Status), Roles, Preconditions, a Flow table with exactly the columns Step | Name | Description | Test Data | Use Case numbered from 1 without gaps, Validation with numbered bold-named checks, and Postconditions

checklist.name: Verification steps present
checklist.description: Each Flow contains at least one verification row ('-' in the Use Case column) between or after the action steps

checklist.name: End state validated
checklist.description: The lending test case validates the reservation 'Fulfilled' and the copy 'On Loan' (or the loan existing); the waiting-list test case validates the reservation 'Waiting' and the member being on the waiting list

checklist.name: No model or implementation internals
checklist.description: No step, validation, or test data contains BPMN element ids (e.g. Activity_LendBook, Flow_Yes), XML terms, HTTP verbs, SQL, class names, or test framework APIs

checklist.name: Postconditions cleanup inventory
checklist.description: Each Postconditions section lists the records its journey creates or changes with literal values (the reservation, and the loan or the waiting list entry); the seeded member, librarian, and titles are not listed as something to remove
